system:
A wallpaper for the background of a dark desktop application window. Landscape, 3:2. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no people, no user interface, no HUD, no health bars, no windows, no frames, no borders.

THIS IMAGE IS NOT A PHOTOGRAPH AND MUST NOT LOOK LIKE ONE. Each frame below names an ART STYLE and that style is the point of the picture. Commit to it completely: the marks, the palette discipline and the surface of that medium should be obvious at a glance. A frame that comes back as a photograph, or as a soft digital painting of a photograph, has failed even if the composition is perfect.

THE FRAME IS A COMPLETE PICTURE, EDGE TO EDGE. Every part of it has something in it. There is no empty side, no blank field, no plain gradient standing in for a region of the image. If a third of this frame could be cropped away without losing anything, the picture is wrong.

QUIET IS NOT EMPTY, AND THIS IS THE WHOLE CRAFT OF IT. The application lays a large translucent card over the left three quarters of this frame, so that region must be RESTFUL behind text. Restful is achieved with LARGE CALM AREAS OF FLAT OR SMOOTHLY GRADED COLOUR: still water, a bank of cloud, a far ridge, an open sky, a broad snowfield. Those carry tone and colour and almost no fine detail, which is exactly what text can sit on. What must NOT be in the left three quarters is FINE HIGH CONTRAST DETAIL at small scale: dense dither or checkerboard patterns, heavy cross hatching, visible halftone dots, scattered bright specks, busy foliage, gravel, rippled water, hard little highlights. Where the style would normally dither or hatch a gradient, keep those areas to the right side and to the lower corners, use large bands of flat colour on the left instead, and keep any dithering low in contrast.

DEPTH IN LAYERS. Build the picture out of three or four distinct planes receding into the distance, each one a step lighter, cooler and simpler than the one in front of it. A near element may sit at the left or the right edge and be the darkest and most defined thing in the frame. The far planes hold the middle. That layering is what makes a picture look like it has a lot in it while staying calm, and every one of these styles has its own way of doing it.

THE FOCAL POINT IS SMALL, BRIGHT AND WARM, AND IT SITS RIGHT OF CENTRE. Not a large object filling the right quarter: a SMALL AREA of the frame, somewhere in the right third, that is markedly brighter and warmer than everything around it, with the highest local contrast in the picture. Everything else in the frame is subordinate to it and cooler than it.

COLOUR. Build it on an opposition of WARM AGAINST COOL: a warm light in coral, salmon, amber, gold or rose, on a scene whose shadows and distances are blue, slate, teal or violet. The warm light should touch several parts of the frame, not only the focal point. Somebody looking at any part of this image should be able to name a colour they can see.

BUT DO NOT MAKE IT VIVID. This is a background somebody looks at all day, so the colour is CLEARLY PRESENT AND QUIETLY HELD: muted, dusty, slightly greyed, like pigment rather than like light. No neon, no electric saturation, no glowing magenta or cyan, no fluorescent anything. Nothing in this picture should be more colourful than a well printed poster.

TONE. THE PICTURE ITSELF IS DARK. This is the one rule that changed since the last round and it changed because of a measurement. The application lays a dark veil over this picture, and the alpha of that veil is solved per picture so that the area behind the app's card always lands on the same brightness. So a picture that arrives BRIGHT gets a HEAVY veil, and a heavy veil dissolves exactly the marks that make a medium worth looking at: the woodgrain of a block print, the tooth of the paper, the grain of the ink, the weave of the silk. Five pictures in the last round came back as beautiful bright prints and went into the window as smooth brown washes with the print gone.

So do NOT deliver a brightly lit picture of a dim scene. Deliver a picture that is ALREADY DARK, in the way a print pulled in dark inks on a dark ground is dark, or a painting made on a dark surface. The large calm areas sit around a QUARTER of the way up from black, and their COLOUR IS STILL PLAINLY READABLE at that tone: a deep indigo that is obviously indigo, a deep slate teal that is obviously teal. The small warm focal point sits around two thirds of the way up and is the only bright thing.

AND THE MEDIUM MUST BE VISIBLE IN THE DARK. The marks of the style are made in tones NEAR the ground, in the dark register, not by lighting the picture up. Nothing here is pure black, nothing is crushed to a flat void, and no area is so dark that its colour and its texture stop being readable. A dark picture is not an underexposed one: it is a picture whose whole tonal range has been composed low on purpose, with the full range of the medium's marks still inside it.

THE TOP TENTH of the frame stays plain and uneventful across the full width.

heroes.name: Orbit Dawn
heroes.prompt: A 1970s AIRBRUSHED SCIENCE FICTION PAPERBACK COVER PAINTING, in the tradition of the great airbrush illustrators of that era. Soft graded airbrush surfaces, clean hard masked edges where shapes meet, matte pigment, slight paper tooth, no photographic grain and no lens flare. The dark side of a quiet blue grey planet seen from close orbit, with the sunrise line crossing it. The planet's surface fills the lower two thirds as a very large smoothly graded curved field in deep indigo and slate, calm and almost featureless on the left, with soft cloud banding lying along the curve. The terminator runs down through the right third as a soft warm edge, and where it meets the limb a small intense area of dusty amber and coral catches the first light, the brightest thing in the frame. Above the limb, deep blue violet space with only a very few faint stars, none of them bright. No nebula, no gas cloud, no galaxy, no bright starfield.

heroes.name: Orbit Rings
heroes.prompt: A 1970s AIRBRUSHED SCIENCE FICTION PAPERBACK COVER PAINTING. Soft graded airbrush surfaces, clean hard masked edges, matte pigment, slight paper tooth, no photographic grain and no lens flare. The view from the night side of a moon, looking up at the ringed gas giant it orbits. The lower third is the moon's own dark surface, a broad calm plain of deep slate that runs the full width with two low smooth ridges stepping back into haze on the left. Above it the giant's disc rises in the right half, a large field of smoothly graded dusty rose and grey with soft horizontal banding, cut by the thin ellipse of its rings crossing behind it. The sun sits just off the right edge, out of frame, and lights a narrow crescent of the giant and a small bright warm section of the near ring in amber, the one bright warm point. The left of the sky is a broad calm field of deep blue violet with a very few dim stars. No nebula, no bright starfield.

heroes.name: Orbit Moonrise
heroes.prompt: A 1970s AIRBRUSHED SCIENCE FICTION PAPERBACK COVER PAINTING. Soft graded airbrush surfaces, clean hard masked edges where shapes meet, matte pigment, slight paper tooth, no photographic grain, no lens flare. Looking across the curve of a large dark planet at a small moon rising over its limb. The planet's flank fills the whole lower half as an enormous smooth dark curved field of deep teal slate, with two faint soft cloud bands and one barely readable continent edge at the left. The limb crosses the frame low and the thin atmosphere sits on it as a soft graded band, coolest at the left and warming towards the right. Right of centre a small pale moon stands just clear of the limb, lit warm ivory on its left side, with a compact glow of dusty amber in the atmosphere directly beneath it. The upper half is a large calm field of deep indigo with very few faint stars. No nebula, no gas cloud, no bright starfield.

heroes.name: Orbit Shadow
heroes.prompt: A 1970s AIRBRUSHED SCIENCE FICTION PAPERBACK COVER PAINTING. Soft graded airbrush surfaces, hard masked edges, matte pigment, slight paper tooth, no photographic grain, no lens flare. A quiet eclipse seen from orbit. A very large dark planet occupies the left two thirds of the frame as one enormous smooth curved field of deep blue slate, almost featureless, its edge sweeping from the lower left up to the right. Behind it the sun is hidden, and the whole rim of the planet from the centre to the right third is edged in a fine soft ring of warm amber and coral light, brightest in a small section right of centre where the atmosphere is thickest. Beyond the rim, a large calm field of deep violet space fills the upper right with a very few faint stars. The rim light lays a faint warm bloom into the space just outside it. No nebula, no gas cloud, no galaxy, no bright starfield.

heroes.name: Moon Reeds
heroes.prompt: A CHINESE INK LANDSCAPE PAINTING ON DARK SILK, in the classical mineral pigment tradition: ink outlines of varying weight, flat mineral azurite and malachite washes, bands of mist left as soft unpainted wash, a matte aged surface, no photographic depth of field, no western perspective shading. THE SILK ITSELF IS A DEEP INDIGO GROUND, so the whole picture is dark and the ink and mineral washes are read against it. A still marsh at night. A stand of tall ink drawn reeds enters at the left edge, the darkest and sharpest thing in the frame. Beyond it a broad calm water fills the centre and lower half as one large flat field of deep blue green wash. Two low far banks step away behind it in paler cooler wash with soft bands of mist between them. In the right third a large soft moon sits low above the far bank, painted as a plain warm ivory disc with a faint gold halo, the brightest and warmest thing in the picture, laying a soft warm sheen along the mist and a short broken warm line on the water below it.

heroes.name: Moon Pines
heroes.prompt: A CHINESE INK LANDSCAPE PAINTING ON DARK SILK, classical mineral pigment tradition: ink outlines of varying weight, flat azurite and malachite washes, mist left as soft pale wash, matte aged surface, no photographic depth of field, no western perspective shading. THE SILK IS A DEEP SLATE BLUE GROUND and the picture is dark throughout. A mountain valley at night. A single ink drawn pine leans in from the left edge over a dark bluff, the sharpest thing in the frame. Behind it three ranges of mountains step away to the right, each a flatter and paler mineral wash than the last, with broad bands of mist lying between them across the whole width. The lower third is a calm valley floor of flat deep green blue wash. In the right third a large soft moon hangs between the second and third range, a plain warm ivory disc with a faint gold halo, and the mist nearest it takes a soft warm cast. Nothing else in the picture is bright.

heroes.name: Moon River
heroes.prompt: A CHINESE INK LANDSCAPE PAINTING ON DARK SILK, classical mineral pigment tradition: ink outlines of varying weight, flat mineral washes, mist as soft pale wash, matte aged surface, no photographic depth of field, no western perspective shading. THE SILK IS A DEEP INK BLUE GROUND and the whole picture sits low and dark against it. A wide river at night seen from a low bank. The water fills the bottom half as one very large calm flat field of deep blue green, carrying only a few long carved ripple lines. A dark ink drawn rock and a single small moored boat sit at the left edge in silhouette. Three flat headlands recede along the far bank towards the right, each paler than the last, with mist between them. In the right third a large soft moon stands just above the farthest headland as a plain warm ivory disc with a faint gold halo, and beneath it a long soft warm reflection runs down the water, the brightest thing in the frame.

heroes.name: Moon Terraces
heroes.prompt: A CHINESE INK LANDSCAPE PAINTING ON DARK SILK, classical mineral pigment tradition: ink outline of varying weight, flat azurite and malachite washes, mist left as soft pale wash, matte aged surface, no photographic depth of field, no western perspective shading. THE SILK IS A DEEP INDIGO GROUND and the picture is composed low and dark. Flooded terraces on a hillside at night, seen slightly from above. The terraces run across the whole frame as long smooth curved bands of still water, each a flat field of deep blue green wash separated by fine dark ink lines, and they are calm and almost featureless on the left. A dark ink drawn tree and a low roof stand at the left edge. The hillside steps up and away to the right into broad bands of mist. In the right third a large soft moon sits low over the far ridge as a plain warm ivory disc with a faint gold halo, and the three nearest terraces below it hold short warm ivory reflections of it. Nothing else is bright.

heroes.name: Pixel Harbour
heroes.prompt: 16-bit PIXEL ART, in the manner of a beautiful Super Nintendo era role playing game background. Chunky visible square pixels, a strict limited palette of about twenty colours, hard pixel edges, no anti aliasing, no blur anywhere. A small harbour at night. The water fills the lower half as three flat bands of deep indigo and slate with a few single pixel ripple lines. A dark pixel quay with two low buildings and a moored boat runs along the left edge in near black silhouette. Three flat headlands step away to the right in deeper and deeper blue. In the right third a small lighthouse stands on the last headland with a warm amber lamp, the brightest thing in the frame, throwing a short column of warm pixels down the water and a soft warm notch along the headland edge. The sky is four broad flat horizontal bands of deep blue violet, with no scattered bright pixel stars on the left and only a light dither where the bands meet on the right.

heroes.name: Pixel Mesa
heroes.prompt: 16-bit PIXEL ART, Super Nintendo era role playing game background. Chunky visible square pixels, a strict limited palette of about twenty colours, hard pixel edges, no anti aliasing, no blur. A desert of flat topped mesas at night. Four flat bands of mesa recede from the left edge to the right, the nearest almost black with a few pixel cacti along its rim, the farthest a dusty violet. The desert floor across the bottom is two broad flat bands of deep plum and slate. The sky above is a large calm field of deep blue violet in three or four broad flat bands with a very few dim pixel stars, none bright, and no dither at all on the left. In the right third a low warm crescent moon sits just above the third mesa in a small pocket of dusty amber and rose sky, and its light lays a warm amber notch along the rims of the two mesas nearest it.

heroes.name: Lino Coast
heroes.prompt: A REDUCTION LINOCUT PRINT pulled in dark inks on a dark ground. The whole picture is dark and the marks are made just above the ground tone. Visible gouge marks of a lino cutting tool, chunky carved shapes, slight ink texture and a little misregistration between the two or three ink layers, the matte surface of pressed paper, no photographic detail and no fine cross hatching in the left three quarters. A rocky coast at night. A carved headland enters at the left edge in the darkest ink. The sea fills the centre and lower half as one large flat field of deep indigo carrying only a few long carved wave lines, widely spaced. Three flat headlands step away to the right in slightly paler inks. In the right third a small warm amber moon sits just above the farthest headland, cut as a clean disc, with a short carved column of warm ink under it on the water and a warm rim along the headland below it. The sky is one broad calm field of deep blue with a few carved cloud lines near the top right.

heroes.name: Cyano Ridge
heroes.prompt: A CYANOTYPE PRINT, the deep Prussian blue photographic print process, on heavy watercolour paper. The whole image is built from that single deep blue, dark and rich, with the paper's grain and brush edges visible and small irregular tide marks where the emulsion was laid, plus a SECOND hand applied ink in dusty warm amber used sparingly for the light only. A range of ridges at dusk in four overlapping layers, each a flat field of the blue at a different density, the nearest at the lower left almost black. Broad flat bands of mist lie between the layers as paler blue washes. The sky is one large calm field of deep blue. In the right third a small amber sun sits just above the third ridge, hand painted in the warm ink, and the same warm ink glazes the top edges of the two nearest ridges and a thin band along the horizon. No halftone dots anywhere in the left three quarters.

heroes.name: Iso Valley
heroes.prompt: A FLAT ISOMETRIC VECTOR ILLUSTRATION, built entirely from clean geometric planes of flat colour with hard straight edges and no texture, no gradient mesh, no outline. The whole scene is composed dark, in deep slate, indigo and deep green, with the planes distinguished by small steps of tone rather than by brightness. A valley seen in isometric projection. Large flat angular fields step down from the upper left to a still lake that fills the centre and lower left as one big flat plane of deep blue green. Three angular ridges recede to the right, each a slightly different flat dark tone, with flat bands of mist between them as single translucent planes. A cluster of small dark geometric conifers stands at the left edge. In the right third a small warm amber sun sits low between two ridges as a plain circle, and three or four flat planes nearest it are filled in warm amber and dusty coral instead of blue, the only warm shapes in the picture.

heroes.name: Cel Dusk
heroes.prompt: A HAND PAINTED ANIME BACKGROUND CEL from a 1990s film, painted in flat poster colour with visible brush edges and clean hard shape boundaries, matte and slightly chalky, no digital gradients and no photographic detail. The scene is painted DARK: deep blues and slates throughout, with the light held in one small area. A country road at nightfall. A dark hedgerow and a single leaning telegraph pole run along the left edge in near black silhouette. Beyond them a broad flat field of deep blue green sweeps across the centre, and three low hills step away to the right in flatter and cooler paint with soft flat bands of evening mist between them. The sky above is one large calm field graded slowly from deep indigo at the top to a dusty slate at the horizon. In the right third a small warm break in the cloud glows dusty amber and rose just above the second hill, the brightest thing in the frame, and a little of that warmth catches the top edge of the nearest hill and one flat band of the mist.

heroes.name: Screen Night
heroes.prompt: A THREE COLOUR SCREEN PRINTED POSTER pulled on dark charcoal paper, in the manner of a modern national park print. Three flat opaque inks only, deep teal, deep slate blue and a dusty amber, each laid as a large flat shape with a slightly ragged printed edge and a little visible ink texture, with the dark paper itself doing the work of the darkest tone. No gradients, no halftone in the left three quarters, no photographic detail. A lake and mountains at night. A flat near shore of the dark paper runs along the bottom with two simple ink drawn conifers at the left edge. The lake is one large flat field of the deep teal filling the centre and left, carrying three long straight amber reflection bars only on its right side. Three mountain shapes step back to the right in the two blues. In the right third a small amber moon sits in a notch between the two farthest peaks, and a thin amber rim runs along the ridge line nearest it.
